fullTextZH: 我小时候有很长的头发，
fullTextEN: When I was young, I had very long hair,
But when I was 12 years old,

fullTextZH: 我的妈妈带我去剪头发。
fullTextEN: my mom took me to get a haircut.
because I didn't want to cut my hair.

fullTextZH: 你猜猜为什么我的妈妈要我剪头发呢？
fullTextEN: Can you guess why my mom wanted me to cut my hair?

fullTextZH: 其实，很多台湾的男孩女孩在12岁的时候都要剪头发，
fullTextEN: Actually, many Taiwanese boys and girls have to cut their hair at the age of 12,

fullTextZH: 今天，我要告诉你这个故事。
fullTextEN: Today, I want to tell you this story.

fullTextZH: 就是12到15岁的学生，是不可以有长头发的。
fullTextEN: that is, students aged 12 to 15, were not allowed to have long hair.

fullTextZH: 男生的头发要剪得短短的，
fullTextEN: Boys' hair had to be cut short,

fullTextZH: 女生的头发也是短短的，
就是用很烫很烫的东西让头发变得卷卷的。
fullTextEN: which means using very hot things to make hair curly.
You also can't dye your hair,
which means changing the color of your hair.

fullTextZH: 不可以是黄色、绿色或蓝色的。
fullTextEN: it can't be yellow, green, or blue.

fullTextZH: 所以，我12岁要上国中的时候就剪了头发。
fullTextEN: So, when I was 12 and about to enter middle school, I cut my hair.

fullTextZH: 老师会检查我们的头发，

fullTextEN: If someone's hair was too long,

fullTextZH: 老师就拿剪刀剪他的头发。
fullTextEN: the teacher would cut their hair with scissors.

fullTextZH: 如果有人的头发很奇怪，

fullTextEN: The teacher will be very angry,

fullTextZH: 要求他把头发变得跟大家一样。
fullTextEN: demanding him to make his hair like everyone else's.

fullTextZH: 她出生的时候头发就卷卷的，
fullTextEN: When she was born, her hair was curly,
It was curly from a young age.
The teacher saw her and said:

fullTextZH: 然后，老师拿剪刀剪了她的头发。
fullTextEN: Then, the teacher took scissors and cut her hair.

fullTextZH: 老师也不可以剪学生的头发。
fullTextEN: The teacher also cannot cut students' hair.

fullTextZH: 因为学生会花很多时间在头发上，
fullTextEN: because students will spend a lot of time on their hair,
and won't have time to study.

fullTextZH: 你在学校的时候，可以有自己喜欢的发型吗？
fullTextEN: When you were in school, could you have your favorite hairstyle?

fullTextZH: 你觉得像台湾学校这样是好还是不好呢？
fullTextEN: Do you think it's good or bad like Taiwanese schools?

fullTextZH: 请留言告诉我你的看法吧！
fullTextEN: Please leave a comment and tell me your thoughts!
